title: Patrick Mahomes will wear a brace on his knee, "I can still move and be myself with it"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Patrick Mahomes will wear a brace on his knee, "I can still move and be myself with it"
sources.description: "It's not like I've been told I have to wear it or how long I have to wear it. It's just going to be my comfortability how I feel," Mahomes said.
